svg.text: 1. NOT YET CHECKED: VERIFY PARTS, PINOUTS AND LENGTHS AGAINST THE DATASHEETS AND DESIGN BEFORE RELEASE.
2. FABRICATE, INSPECT AND TEST PER IPC/WHMA-A-620, CLASS 2.
3. ALL DIMENSIONS IN MM. LENGTHS ARE MEASURED FROM CONNECTOR REAR FACE TO BREAKOUT CENTRE OR TO THE NEXT CONNECTOR REAR FACE.
4. LENGTH TOLERANCES UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: ≤300: ±5, ≤1000: ±10, over: ±1%. SEGMENT DIMENSIONS GOVERN; OVERALL DIMENSIONS ARE REFERENCE.
5. DRAWING NOT TO SCALE. WIRE CUT LENGTHS PER WIRE LIST; CONNECTIONS PER CONNECTOR TABLES AND WIRING DIAGRAM.
6. CONTINUITY-TEST 100% AGAINST THE WIRE LIST; NO SHORTS BETWEEN NETS.
